scripts.dev:db:reset: cd apps/api && docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m fastapi dev main.py
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run python worker.py
scripts.test:api:unit: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/unit
